Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

move.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price – volume-based contract proposal
move.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer and the explanation of the market movements. I appreciate the continuity of supply from your inventory. Rather than carry the annual increases straight into the new price, I would like to review the calculation against a binding volume and a longer contract.

Our proposed packages commit to 94800 kg per year throughout a 24-month term, with the same annual quantity in each year. Our purchase-order history supports the running business; see the figures below. Which discount tier in your price list does this commitment qualify for?

We propose 90 days net and an AS-14404 index clause. The packages are EUR 5.31 per kg with a 5% deadband, EUR 5.27 per kg with a 3% deadband, or EUR 5.20 per kg without a deadband. Each package has the same volume commitment, payment terms and contract duration.

Please let us know which package best fits your calculation and explain how the volume discount is reflected. That would give us a concrete basis for agreeing the base price and alloy mechanism together.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

Our purchase orders po:4500014305-10, po:4500014391-10 and po:4500014455-10 for part:370010 were placed with you at EUR 5.45 per unit.

strategy:
Supplier: Edelstahl-Service Donautal (stainless bar stockholder, group company, inside sales desk). Public notes:
its letter of 2026-07-06 says its nickel/alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027; the owner
offered in April to walk us through their calculation. In every past exchange it asked "Which volume can you commit
to?" and said it cannot adjust its calculation without exact volume figures; it also mentioned "Preisliste and
discount tiers". It insists on an AS-14404 index clause for a 24-month term and freely accepts 90-day payment.
Plan: ROUND 1 - answer the volume question truthfully and precisely (the fixed case volume per year is binding, state it
and the total over the contract term), cite our purchase orders as proof of the running volume, accept the index
clause ourselves (choose clause packages with deadband 5 and 3, plus one deadband 0), 90 days, 24 months, deep level
(L6-L7). Ask which discount tier that binding volume reaches. ROUND 2 - thank it for what it accepted, add the
PPI-C2431 index fall claim, move one level toward it (never repeat a sheet), keep the volume commitment explicit.
ROUND 3 - add one more element (scorecard, or ask it to put the package to its management), move a little.
ROUND 4-5 - converge; code will accept when it agrees or goes final. Tone: warm, concrete, partner-like, short.
IMPORTANT: do NOT use any AS-14404 index claim with this supplier - its own letter says its alloys are hedged until
March 2027, and it answered that claim before with "that is not our reality". Use the PO-history claim in round 1
(proof of volume) and the PPI-C2431 fall in round 2. Levels: round 1 around L5-L6 for the deadband-5 sheet, with the
deadband-3 and deadband-0 sheets at the same level (equal cost for us).
